asr.full_text: Hello, everyone. I just got off of work and I ordered some stuff from Ulta for my birthday that I got a gift card for my birthday and I wore some stuff offline and when I got off I saw that my package had come in so I'm gonna go ahead and do a quick little unboxing see I don't remember everything that I ordered. Lets see, so basically this was um... $50 worth of stuff. a little bit over maybe a little over Maybe with anything in the package in here it would say... I guess they don't put a price in case it's a gift or something, I don't know I've never noticed that before. But I didn't get too much. I'll grab these. First thing I'm going to pull out is some Ardell lashes that I bought. And they're a Demi Whiskies. And this one just says Demi. This is a four pack that they had a sale on that I bought. And then this is a little two pack, twin pack. Those right there. I don't know. I think it looks like the same style Matte Finish Setting Spray. And it's 2.3 fluid ounces. And I'll put the pricing in the description or the links to the products on Ulta's site. That is that right there. I can't wait to try this out because I know this is pretty cheap. So, I hope it works good. Next thang is another thing from Nyx, and I picked up Illuminator, but this is another thing that I haven't tried yet. Well, I haven't tried really any of these. These are all products that are fairly new to me, but I have seen other people use them. It says Illuminator in ritualistic is the color. Looks like that. So let's see. let see let see ooo i like that you said i don't know how well i can see it you can see all my veins but there yeah you can see that i like that cant wait to try that. Okay, and one more thing. This is going to be a very quick video I guess. This is Lorac alter ego heartbreaker eyeshadow palette. Box looks like that take it out I think the main reason I wanted to get this is for the blue I don't have it was like, and it's a pretty pastel-blue, I can't get anything open. This is cute, it's pink... it's cute. I don't think this is very expensive, well it couldn't have been very expensive because I spent 50 dollars. It doesn't come with a brush or anything, which I don't need anyways. It does come with a big mirror. Those are the colors right there. This is the blue that I wanted I'm wanting it for, it's pretty. It almost looks kinda whitish on the skin. Yeah, it's pretty. It's very... I like the pigmentation of it too and it looks like it also comes with a highlighter like right there. I am excited to try this out. I will have to do some looks with this. And, that's about it. That's what I ordered. So I'm excited. I guess that'll do it. Thanks for watching. Subscribe if you haven't. Please do check out some other vids. Thanks for watching !
